Name: No Fence Decay Updated for 1.6.2 (Original by CatCattyCat)
Author: GhostWitch145
AuthorLabel: Made by CatCattyCat and Updated by GhostWitch
Description:
CatCattyCat's No Fence Decay mod updated to work in 1.6.2. All I did was remove some outdated code and it appears to working without it. If there are any issues, please let me know!

Original (NOT compatible with 1.6.2): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1180?tab=description

Requires SMAPI 4.0.1: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=files

Downloads.Description: Makes all fences and gates last forever by repairing them to full health every morning. Works with fences and gates placed anywhere, on all fence types.

Manifest.Name: No Fence Decay
Manifest.Description: Makes all fences and gates last forever.
